turns.content: A cyclic pinacol precursor A gives 2,2-di-p-tolylcyclohexan-1-one under H2SO4. Explain how migration of a ring C-C bond changes ring size in a pinacol rearrangement.
Infer the ring size of A. Then identify the adjacent alcohol-bearing carbons and their substituents in methyl 2,3-dihydroxy-2-(p-tolyl)butanoate.
For the acyclic substrate, decide which OH group is protonated and lost as water, and identify the resulting carbocation.
From that carbocation, determine which adjacent group migrates into the cationic center, identify the carbonyl carbon formed, and name product B.
Name A and B and relate each structure to its decisive migration.
Check that A undergoes one-carbon ring expansion and that the selected migration in the second reaction gives the proposed beta-keto-ester connectivity.
Report A, B, and the two migration steps.
